name: threads
description: Threads: a Slack-like collaboration app and multiplayer agent platform.

scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix client run test:unit
scripts.check:threads: npm run lint && npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix api run openapi:check && npm --prefix agent-tools/cli run check && npm run check:bridge && npm --prefix client run check && npm --prefix client run test:unit
scripts.api:contract:check: npm run api:contract:validate && npm run api:contract:test && npm run api:contract:build
scripts.threads: npm --prefix agent-tools/cli run build --silent && node agent-tools/cli/dist/cli.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && npm run db:migrate:remote

INSTANCE_SECRET.description: Required. Generate a stable secret with `openssl rand -base64 32`. On a new instance, sign in as `admin` with this value, then change the password.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. Resend API key for verification, invitation, and feedback email delivery.

AUTH_EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional. Verified sender address for account email, for example `Threads <threads@example.com>`.

FEEDBACK_EMAIL_TO.description: Optional. Instance-owned destination for feedback email. Feedback stays in Threads when omitted.

FEEDBACK_EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional. Verified sender address for feedback email.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional. Public VAPID key; omit to disable Web Push.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional. Private VAPID key; omit to disable Web Push.

VAPID_SUBJECT.description: Optional. VAPID contact URI such as `mailto:admin@example.com`.
